title: [Subcontracting] Bug 648937: Transfer WIP Item is lost when production orders are created from Planning Worksheet
summary: Transfers of WIP items configured on production routings are now preserved when production orders are created from the Planning Worksheet, maintaining the connection between planning and production orders.
key_points: Transfer WIP Item and transfer descriptions are now stored on planning routing lines
Values are propagated from routing lines through Planning Worksheet carry-out to production order routing lines
Support includes both certified routing versions and base routings
Integration tests added to verify the behavior
Fixes data loss issue when creating production orders from planning worksheet
quote: preserve Transfer WIP Item and transfer descriptions on Planning Routing Line
